svg.title: How an opportunity is ranked. A relevance score out of 100 is built from six parts: risk alignment up to 25 points, goal alignment up to 25, affordability up to 20, age suitability up to 15, savings rate fit up to 10, and the AI's own confidence up to 5. Risk alignment rewards an exact match of your risk appetite. Goal alignment matches keywords, for example retirement to PPF, NPS and pension, or wealth creation to index, equity, mutual fund and SIP. Age suitability favours growth under 30, balance under 40, stability under 55 and capital preservation after that. Scores map to stars: 80 and above is highly recommended (five stars), 60 and above a good fit (four), 40 and above a moderate fit (three), below 40 not recommended (one).

Risk alignment rewards an exact match of your risk appetite. Goal alignment matches keywords, for example retirement to PPF, NPS and pension, or wealth creation to index, equity, mutual fund and SIP. Age suitability favours growth under 30, balance under 40, stability under 55 and capital preservation after that. div.p: Every discovered opportunity is scored against the person, not the market. Six transparent parts add up to 100.

div.div: Risk and goalExact risk match earns the full 25. Goals map to keywords: retirement to PPF, NPS and pension; wealth creation to index, equity, mutual funds and SIP.
AgeUnder 30 leans to growth, under 40 to balance, under 55 to stability, then to capital preservation.
Saving and confidenceHigh savers can take more market risk; very low savers are steered to an emergency fund first. The AI's confidence adds up to 5.
